name: Ziguang
source:
A mysterious man, who might (or might not) be a bad guy.

But is he a [i]bad guy[/i]?

He seems charming, but awfully suspicious.

[From [url=https://bigmamafatcat.itch.io/dearest-darling-dragon]itch.io[/url]]
